items.title: Qwen2.5-1M: Deploy Your Own Qwen with Context Length up to 1M Tokens
items.summary: Tech Report HuggingFace ModelScope Qwen Chat HuggingFace Demo ModelScope Demo DISCORD Introduction Two months after upgrading Qwen2.5-Turbo to support context length up to one million tokens, we are back with the open-source Qwen2.5-1M models and the corresponding inference framework support. Here’s what you can expect from this release: Opensource Models: We’re releasing two new checkpoints, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M a
items.summaryZh: 通义千问正式发布并开源了Qwen2.5-1M模型系列，包含Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M两个全新检查点。这是其开源大模型首次升级至支持高达100万Token的超长上下文处理能力，并配套了相应的推理框架优化，极大地扩展了开源社区在长文本任务上的应用潜力。

items.title: Qwen2.5 VL! Qwen2.5 VL! Qwen2.5 VL!
items.summary: QWEN CHAT GITHUB HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE DISCORD We release Qwen2.5-VL, the new flagship vision-language model of Qwen and also a significant leap from the previous Qwen2-VL. To try the latest model, feel free to visit Qwen Chat and choose Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct. items.summaryZh: 通义千问正式发布了全新旗舰视觉语言模型Qwen2.5-VL，作为Qwen2-VL的重大升级。该系列同时开源了3B、7B和72B三种规模的基础版与指令微调版，支持在Hugging Face和ModelScope上获取。它具备强大的视觉理解与多模态交互能力，为开源多模态AI领域树立了新的技术标杆。
